writing_goals: open with a strong hook in the first sentence that creates real curiosity or anticipation
lead with the immediate game premise or discovery
use curiosity-driven framing without replacing useful facts with hype
build toward a standout, surprising, or most-interesting detail rather than a flat recap of facts in original order
keep setup compact and retain specific game details
prefer conversational wording and natural reactions, like a content creator talking to their audience
favor short-form pacing, high information density, and natural transitions
use conversational endings rather than corporate calls to action
avoid: generic hype that replaces or removes factual information
invented game features, dates, platforms, prices, or developers
